decks.notes: The Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly buffing up creatures and dealing damage to the opponent as fast as possible. With a mix of low-cost spells to enhance creatures and efficient creatures to attack with, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes protection spells to keep key creatures safe from removal or combat damage. By combining aggressive creatures with pump spells, the Boros Aggro deck aims to win the game through fast and relentless attacks.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with threats on the board. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber and Sheoldred's Edict, while also using creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodletter of Aclazotz to pressure the opponent. The mana base includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to support the control strategy.

This deck focuses on using Lotus Field as a key piece in a combo strategy to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By using cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to untap Lotus Field, the player can cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The deck also includes protection cards like Strict Proctor and Bala Ged Recovery to maintain board control and resilience. The goal is to set up a powerful win condition by chaining together spells and using the mana advantage provided by Lotus Field to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around fast-paced aggression, utilizing cards that can quickly deal damage to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize. With a focus on Rakdos colors, the deck includes various creatures and spells that can quickly close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion offers additional value and flexibility to the deck. The mana base is constructed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using Arclight Phoenix as a recurring threat. It includes spells to quickly fill the graveyard to bring back the Phoenix, as well as disruption and card draw to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of burn spells and evasion, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ledger Shredder allows for additional card advantage and graveyard manipulation to maximize the deck's potential.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, allowing for powerful early plays. The deck then aims to flood the board with high devotion creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, supported by cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival. By leveraging the devotion to green theme, this deck can overwhelm opponents with efficient and powerful creatures while utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for additional advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value, such as recursion with Claim/Fame and disruption with Thoughtseize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck's mana base. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent, forcing them to react quickly or risk losing the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw. Its key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's plans while establishing a strong board presence with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. The deck also utilizes land destruction and graveyard hate to further control the game. The goal is to outlast the opponent by efficiently managing resources and outplaying them with strategic decision-making. By maintaining control of the game tempo and resources, this deck aims to grind the opponent down and secure victory through attrition.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a board presence with Arclight Phoenix and Picklock Prankster while keeping the opponent's board in check with efficient removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse. Using cards like Opt and Consider to draw cards and find key pieces like Treasure Cruise, the deck aims to be aggressive and maintain card advantage. By utilizing cheap spells and counters like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to close out games quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Proft's Eidetic Memory helps to provide additional card advantage and ensure consistency in drawing into key cards.

This deck focuses on quickly bringing back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard by casting multiple spells in a turn. Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster help facilitate this strategy by filling up the graveyard with cheap spells. The deck also includes card draw spells like Consider and Opt to help find more spells to cast. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal options while Spell Pierce helps protect key spells. Treasure Cruise and Proft's Eidetic Memory provide additional card advantage. The mana base includes a mix of blue and red sources to support the aggressive spellcasting strategy.

The key concept of this Boros Control deck is to use a combination of removal spells and powerful enchantments to control the board and outvalue the opponent. Cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and High Noon provide card advantage, while Torch the Tower and Caretaker's Talent deal with threats efficiently. The deck aims to control the game by maintaining a strong presence on the board with cards like The Wandering Emperor and Sunfall while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Get Lost and March of Otherworldly Light. Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin provide additional utility and disruption options.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and The Wandering Emperor. It also uses cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Chained to the Rocks to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on combining cards creatively to generate unexpected and powerful plays, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creatures and spells. The deck requires careful timing and strategy to maximize its potential and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently search for powerful creatures and enchantments to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck includes a variety of creatures with different abilities to adapt to various situations, as well as enchantments like Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board. The inclusion of Chained to the Rocks and Torch the Tower provides removal options, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps with card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the diverse color requirements of the deck for consistent performance.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence through powerful creatures like Bishop of Wings, Resplendent Angel, and Skyclave Apparition. The deck utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to cast multiple threats early in the game. Righteous Valkyrie and Giada, Font of Hope provide additional value and lifegain to outlast opponents. Collected Company helps dig for key creatures, while March of Otherworldly Light can clear the path for a lethal attack. The deck also includes some removal and board wipe options to handle opposing threats.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. This deck utilizes a combination of counterspells, removal spells, board wipes, and card draw effects to control the pace of the game. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for more card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can establish a dominant position to close out the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's plans while gaining incremental advantages with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The main win condition is through grinding out the opponent with powerful control spells and eventually overwhelming them with a combination of planeswalkers and creature threats. The deck also utilizes a companion to provide additional support and flexibility in certain matchups. It excels at outlasting opponents and managing the board state to secure victory.
